sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: What I've done is fill this out.
sentences.zh: 我所做的就是把它填好。

sentences.en: I'll leave it on the door so that the owner is aware of the fact that we made a visit
sentences.zh: 我会把它留在门上，让房主知道我们来过，

sentences.en: and that they need to take care of the lawn.
sentences.zh: 而且他们需要打理一下草坪。

sentences.en: They may not even be aware of the fact that the city of Gainesville has an ordinance that prohibits excessive growth.
sentences.zh: 他们可能根本不知道盖恩斯维尔市有一项禁止草坪过度生长的法令。

sentences.en: In communities across America, lawns that are brown or overgrown are considered especially heinous.
sentences.zh: 在美国各地的社区里，枯黄或杂草丛生的草坪被认为尤其令人发指。

sentences.en: Elite squads of dedicated individuals have been deputized by their local governments or homeowners associations
sentences.zh: 当地政府或业主协会已经授权了一支支敬业的精英小队，

sentences.en: to take action against those whose lawns fail to meet community standards.
sentences.zh: 对那些草坪不符合社区标准的住户采取行动。

sentences.en: Call them lawn enforcement agents.
sentences.zh: 称他们为“草坪执法人员”吧。

sentences.en: Producer Sam Greenspan.
sentences.zh: 制片人萨姆·格林斯潘。

sentences.en: This is his story.
sentences.zh: 这就是他的故事。

sentences.en: In 2008, a lawn enforcement agent stopped by a home in Hudson, Florida, outside of Tampa.
sentences.zh: 2008年，一名草坪执法人员来到佛罗里达州坦帕市郊外哈德逊的一户人家。

sentences.en: Maybe the agent snapped some photos.
sentences.zh: 也许执法人员拍了一些照片。

sentences.en: Maybe there were some boxes ticked off a checkliSt.
sentences.zh: 也许在检查清单上勾选了几项。

sentences.en: Whatever the agent's field methods, he or she went back to Lawn Enforcement HQ and sent out a letter.
sentences.zh: 无论执法人员的实地工作方法如何，他或她回到了草坪执法总部并寄出了一封信。

sentences.en: They send out letters stating that, you know, your lawn's not up to paw.
sentences.zh: 他们寄出的信里会说，你知道，你的草坪不达标。

sentences.en: You have a lot of bear spots.
sentences.zh: 你有很多秃斑。

sentences.en: You have a lot of weeds.
sentences.zh: 你有很多杂草。

sentences.en: My sprinkler system was busted and I didn't have the money at that time to repair it.
sentences.zh: 我的喷灌系统坏了，当时我没钱修理它。

sentences.en: That's Joe Prudente, who, with his wife Pat, owns the home in question.
sentences.zh: 那是乔·普鲁登特，他和妻子帕特拥有这栋房子。

sentences.en: Lawn enforcement thought that the Prudente's lawn was too brown, too weedy, and not well-maintained.
sentences.zh: 草坪执法部门认为普鲁登特家的草坪太枯黄、杂草太多，且维护不善。

sentences.en: This was not the first such letter that the Prudentes had received.
sentences.zh: 这已经不是普鲁登特夫妇收到的第一封此类信件了。

sentences.en: But Joe Prudente says he is no deadbeat.
sentences.zh: 但乔·普鲁登特说他不是个赖账的人。

sentences.en: Over the course of a few years, he had tried to keep a clean, green lawn as best he could.
sentences.zh: 几年下来，他一直尽其所能保持草坪干净、翠绿。

sentences.en: He watered it.
sentences.zh: 他浇过水。

sentences.en: He put down grass seeds and grass plugs.
sentences.zh: 他撒过草种，也补种过草皮。

sentences.en: He even dug up and completely replanted the grass in his front yard three times over.
sentences.zh: 他甚至把前院的草全部挖掉，重新种了三次。

sentences.en: I've done it three times.
sentences.zh: 我做了三次。

sentences.en: The first time I had a company do it, they charged me like, you know, $1,200.
sentences.zh: 第一次我找了一家公司来做，他们收了我大概1200美元。

sentences.en: And I said, I'm not doing this, you know, every time it dies.
sentences.zh: 我说，我可不想每次草一死就这么干。

sentences.en: Joe met with his homeowners association, but they were not cutting him any slack.
sentences.zh: 乔和他的业主协会开了会，但他们一点也不肯通融。

sentences.en: So then finally they did some ruling that if I didn't put sod down the whole place,
sentences.zh: 最后他们裁定，如果我不把整个地方都铺上草皮，

sentences.en: a law firm was sending it to the judge, to the court, to see what would happen.
sentences.zh: 律师事务所就会把它提交给法官和法院，看看会发生什么。

sentences.en: I said, go ahead.
sentences.zh: 我说，随你们便。

sentences.en: You know, what are they going to do, lock me up?
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们能把我怎么样？把我关起来吗？

sentences.en: They're not going to put me in jail for not putting grass down.
sentences.zh: 他们不会因为我不铺草皮就把我关进监狱的。

sentences.en: I said, that's crazy.
sentences.zh: 我说，这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Shortly thereafter, Joe got another letter.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，乔又收到了一封信。

sentences.en: It was a court order to turn myself in or get arrested.
sentences.zh: 那是一份让我自首或被捕的法院传票。

sentences.en: I didn't want everybody to see police coming to the house and carting me away for,
sentences.zh: 我不想让所有人看到警察来到我家，把我带走，因为，

sentences.en: they'd probably go, oh, look at this guy, he's probably robbed the bank, you know.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会想，哦，看看这家伙，他可能抢了银行，你知道的。

sentences.en: You know how neighbors are.
sentences.zh: 你知道邻居们是什么样子的。

sentences.en: So I did it the quiet way.
sentences.zh: 所以我选择了安静的方式。

sentences.en: I turned myself in.
sentences.zh: 我自首了。

sentences.en: At 66 years old, Joe Prudente, an otherwise law-abiding retiree from Long Island,
sentences.zh: 66岁的乔·普鲁登特，一位平时守法的退休人员，来自长岛，

sentences.en: presented himself to the Pasco County Jail wearing a Grandpa Gone Wild t-shirt.
sentences.zh: 穿着一件“狂野爷爷”的T恤向帕斯科县监狱自首。

sentences.en: He was apprehended on allegations of failing to properly maintain his lawn to community standards.
sentences.zh: 他因未能按照社区标准妥善维护草坪的指控而被捕。

sentences.en: There was no bail.
sentences.zh: 没有保释。

sentences.en: No bail until the sod was done.
sentences.zh: 在草皮铺好之前不得保释。

sentences.en: Now, fortunately for Joe, the local paper had written about the arrest and detainment of a senior citizen for having a brown lawn.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，当地报纸报道了这位老人因草坪枯黄而被捕和拘留的消息。

sentences.en: Word got around and dozens of people came to help dig up and re-saw the Prudente's lawn.
sentences.zh: 消息传开了，几十个人赶来帮忙挖掉并重铺了普鲁登特家的草坪。

sentences.en: Joe was released from jail the next day.
sentences.zh: 乔第二天就被释放了。

sentences.en: Most cases of homeowners brushing up against lawn enforcement do not end in jail time.
sentences.zh: 大多数与草坪执法部门发生冲突的业主都不会以坐牢告终。

sentences.en: But Joe Prudente was not the only person to have ended up behind bars because of a landscaping issue.
sentences.zh: 但乔·普鲁登特并不是唯一一个因为景观问题而身陷囹圄的人。

sentences.en: Frank Yeos of Grand Prairie, Texas did two days in jail for having an overgrown lawn.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州大草原城的弗兰克·耶奥斯因为草坪杂草丛生在监狱里待了两天。

sentences.en: And Gary Settle, a 75-year-old former city council member of Rizal, Texas,
sentences.zh: 而德克萨斯州里扎尔市75岁的前市议员加里·塞特尔，

sentences.en: had a warrant issued for her arrest until some neighborhood kids came by
sentences.zh: 一直面临逮捕令，直到一些邻居家的孩子过来，

sentences.en: and mowed the lawn that she had been unable to take care of on her own.
sentences.zh: 帮她修剪了她自己无法打理的草坪。

sentences.en: There's a paradox to the lawn.
sentences.zh: 草坪存在一个悖论。

sentences.en: On the one hand, it is the pedestal on which sits the greatest symbol of the American dream,
sentences.zh: 一方面，它是美国梦最伟大象征的基座，

sentences.en: the home.
sentences.zh: 那就是家。

sentences.en: And homeowners are independent and free and have domain over their own little corner of the world.
sentences.zh: 业主们独立、自由，在自己的一小块天地里拥有主权。

sentences.en: And yet, and yet, the lawn is the least free, will-controlled landscape insofar as people
sentences.zh: 然而，然而，草坪却是最不自由、最受控制的景观，因为人们

sentences.en: are constantly pressured, either by formal or informal institutions, into managing it
sentences.zh: 不断受到正式或非正式机构的压力，被迫去管理它，

sentences.en: just like their neighbors.
sentences.zh: 就像他们的邻居一样。

sentences.en: That's Paul Robbins, director of the Nelson Institute for Environmental Studies at the
sentences.zh: 那是保罗·罗宾斯，威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校

sentences.en: University of Wisconsin-Madison.
sentences.zh: 纳尔逊环境研究所的主任。

sentences.en: And I'm the author of the book Lawn People, How Grasses, Weeds, and Chemicals Make Us Who We Are.
sentences.zh: 我也是《草坪人：草、杂草和化学物质如何塑造了我们》一书的作者。

sentences.en: Grass may be a plant, but a lawn is a designed object.
sentences.zh: 草可能是一种植物，但草坪是一个经过设计的物体。

sentences.en: A lawn is an entirely designed object.
sentences.zh: 草坪是一个完全经过设计的物体。

sentences.en: That kind of imaginary, nice, clean, green lawn, that's an entirely engineered landscape.
sentences.zh: 那种想象中漂亮、干净、翠绿的草坪，是一个完全工程化的景观。

sentences.en: And the reason we maintain this landscape, says Paul Robbins, is about everything except the grass.
sentences.zh: 保罗·罗宾斯说，我们维护这种景观的原因，与草本身无关，而是为了其他一切。

sentences.en: It's about everything else.
sentences.zh: 是为了其他一切。

sentences.en: It's about community.
sentences.zh: 是为了社区。

sentences.en: It's about proper moral behavior.
sentences.zh: 是为了正确的道德行为。

sentences.en: It's about participating in the life of a community.
sentences.zh: 是为了参与社区生活。

sentences.en: Even in the beginning, lawns were always about something else.
sentences.zh: 即使在最初，草坪也总是为了别的东西。

sentences.en: The lawn, or really the idea of lawns, began with art.
sentences.zh: 草坪，或者说草坪的概念，始于艺术。

sentences.en: The Italians, for a while, were painting these sort of pastoral scenes.
sentences.zh: 意大利人曾有一段时间在画这些田园风光。

sentences.en: Scenes full of grasslands and hedges.
sentences.zh: 画中充满了草地和树篱。

sentences.en: Grasslands and hedges that didn't actually exiSt.
sentences.zh: 那些实际上并不存在的草地和树篱。

sentences.en: No, I mean, these are pastoral images out of somebody's imagination of what the landscape
sentences.zh: 不，我的意思是，这些田园意象源于某人对景观应该是什么样子的想象。

sentences.en: should look like.
sentences.zh: 景观应该是什么样子的。

sentences.en: And these paintings got popular among Great Britain's landed elite.
sentences.zh: 这些画在英国的土地精英中流行起来。

sentences.en: They liked the painting so much that they wanted to live in them.
sentences.zh: 他们非常喜欢这些画，以至于想住在画里。

sentences.en: What the British were doing is designing their landscapes to look like what was trending
sentences.zh: 英国人所做的是设计他们的景观，使其看起来像意大利绘画中流行的风格。

sentences.en: in Italian painting.
sentences.zh: 意大利绘画中流行的风格。

sentences.en: So life definitely followed art in this case.
sentences.zh: 所以在这个案例中，生活确实追随了艺术。

sentences.en: A style of English garden developed where a prominent feature is a green lawn.
sentences.zh: 一种英国花园风格发展起来，其显著特征就是绿色的草坪。

sentences.en: And right away, everyone recognized that these soft, verdant grasses were more than just
sentences.zh: 人们很快就意识到，这些柔软、翠绿的草不仅仅是

sentences.en: a nice place to walk around barefoot outside.
sentences.zh: 户外赤脚行走的好地方。

sentences.en: A lawn was about power.
sentences.zh: 草坪关乎权力。

sentences.en: A lawn was a way for these English elites to show off that they were so wealthy that
sentences.zh: 草坪是这些英国精英炫耀他们非常富有的一种方式，因为

sentences.en: they didn't need this land to grow food.
sentences.zh: 他们不需要这片土地来种植食物。

sentences.en: They could afford to let their fields go fallow.
sentences.zh: 他们有能力让田地荒废。

sentences.en: And could afford to keep grazing animals and scythe-wielding peasants to keep it short.
sentences.zh: 也有能力供养放牧的动物和挥舞镰刀的农民来保持草坪短促。

sentences.en: When European colonists set sail for the New World, they took grasses with them.
sentences.zh: 当欧洲殖民者启航前往新大陆时，他们带上了草种。

sentences.en: But lawns were still mostly for rich people and eventually public parks.
sentences.zh: 但草坪仍然主要是富人和后来的公共公园所拥有的。

sentences.en: It wasn't until the turn of the 20th century, with the first suburbs, that lawn started appearing
sentences.zh: 直到20世纪之交，随着第一批郊区的出现，草坪才开始出现在

sentences.en: around the homes of the middle class.
sentences.zh: 中产阶级的家周围。

sentences.en: And here is where the lawn shifts from being about the flagrant display of wealth to a moral
sentences.zh: 正是在这里，草坪从炫耀财富的标志转变为一种文明道德的力量。

sentences.en: force for the good of civilization.
sentences.zh: 文明道德的力量。

sentences.en: Andrew Jackson Downing, considered by some to be the father of American landscape architecture.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁·杰克逊·唐宁，被一些人认为是美国景观建筑之父。

sentences.en: Who is slightly older than the other guy considered to be the father of American landscape architecture,
sentences.zh: 他比另一位被认为是美国景观建筑之父的人稍微年长一些，

sentences.en: Frederick Law Olmsted.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德里克·劳·奥姆斯特德。
zh_words: 弗雷德里克·劳·奥姆斯特德

sentences.en: I know you're thinking it, nerds.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们在想什么，书呆子们。

sentences.en: Downing wrote in 1850, quote,
sentences.zh: 唐宁在1850年写道，引用：

sentences.en: When smiling lawns and tasteful cottages begin to embellish a country, we know that order
sentences.zh: 当微笑的草坪和雅致的小屋开始装饰一个国家时，我们就知道秩序

sentences.en: and culture are established.
sentences.zh: 和文化已经建立。

sentences.en: There was kind of a social message, which is that if you make it look like this, we will
sentences.zh: 这传达了一种社会信息，即如果你把它打理成这样，我们就会

sentences.en: make better citizens.
sentences.zh: 造就更好的公民。

sentences.en: As opposed to, right, living in squalor and the urban areas are considered evil and miasmic
sentences.zh: 而不是，对吧，生活在肮脏的环境中，城市地区被认为是邪恶、有毒

sentences.en: and problematic.
sentences.zh: 且充满问题的。

sentences.en: A well-maintained lawn, in other words, is the opposite of a broken window.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，维护良好的草坪与“破窗效应”恰恰相反。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's precisely that.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: Most people think whatever's going on outside the house, if it's civilized, manicured,
sentences.zh: 大多数人认为房子外面发生的一切，如果是文明的、修剪整齐的、

sentences.en: and well-maintained, reflects something that's going on good inside the house.
sentences.zh: 维护良好的，就反映了房子内部发生的好事。

sentences.en: With the start of the great American suburbanization in the 1950s, suddenly middle-class people
sentences.zh: 随着1950年代美国大郊区化的开始，中产阶级突然

sentences.en: were owning larger and larger swaths of land.
sentences.zh: 拥有了越来越大片的土地。

sentences.en: So covering it with grass was partly utilitarian.
sentences.zh: 所以用草覆盖它在一定程度上是出于实用目的。

sentences.en: You know, you have this big piece of land.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你拥有这么大一块地。

sentences.en: You gotta do something with it.
sentences.zh: 你总得做点什么。

sentences.en: But this connection between lawn and order only grew stronger, and our lawns got bigger.
sentences.zh: 但草坪与秩序之间的这种联系只会变得更强，我们的草坪也变得更大了。

sentences.en: We did an air photography study and use tax assessor's data for Franklin County, which
sentences.zh: 我们对富兰克林县进行了航空摄影研究，并使用了税务评估员的数据，该县

sentences.en: is Columbus, Ohio.
sentences.zh: 就是哥伦布市。

sentences.en: So it's a very typical American city.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常典型的美国城市。

sentences.en: And we found that about 25% of the entire county was turf grass lawns.
sentences.zh: 我们发现整个县大约25%的土地是草坪。

sentences.en: That doesn't include football fields.
sentences.zh: 这还不包括足球场。

sentences.en: It doesn't include golf courses.
sentences.zh: 也不包括高尔夫球场。

sentences.en: A quarter of the entire city of Columbus is lawns, grass living a completely unnatural
sentences.zh: 哥伦布市四分之一的土地是草坪，草过着一种完全不自然的

sentences.en: life cycle.
sentences.zh: 生命周期。

sentences.en: We don't let grass grow tall enough to go to seed, but we also water and fertilize it to
sentences.zh: 我们不让草长到结籽的高度，但我们又浇水施肥来

sentences.en: keep it from going dormant.
sentences.zh: 防止它进入休眠状态。

sentences.en: We don't let it die, but we also don't let it reproduce.
sentences.zh: 我们不让它死，但也不让它繁殖。

sentences.en: The author Michael Pollan wrote that lawns are nature purged of sex and death.
sentences.zh: 作家迈克尔·波伦写道，草坪是剔除了性和死亡的自然。

sentences.en: Feed.
sentences.zh: 喂养。

sentences.en: Weed.
sentences.zh: 除草。

sentences.en: Cut.
sentences.zh: 修剪。

sentences.en: Repeat.
sentences.zh: 重复。

sentences.en: Paul Robbins interviewed dozens of people about their lawns for his book.
sentences.zh: 保罗·罗宾斯为他的书采访了几十个人关于他们草坪的问题。

sentences.en: People told him that if their grass got too long, neighbors would come by and ask if their
sentences.zh: 人们告诉他，如果他们的草长得太长，邻居就会过来问他们的

sentences.en: lawnmower was broken, if they needed to borrow one.
sentences.zh: 割草机是不是坏了，需不需要借一台。

sentences.en: People who wouldn't mow their lawn might find an aggressive neighbor had done it for
sentences.zh: 不割草的人可能会发现，一个激进的邻居在半夜或他们

sentences.en: them in the middle of the night or while they were out of town.
sentences.zh: 外出时已经帮他们割了。

sentences.en: You mow because everybody else does.
sentences.zh: 你割草是因为别人都这么做。

sentences.en: The free market, American, free, neoliberal subject who does as he or she pleases would
sentences.zh: 自由市场、美国式、自由、新自由主义的主体，如果随心所欲，就会

sentences.en: just say, to hell with my neighbors.
sentences.zh: 说，去他的邻居。

sentences.en: I'm just going to let my lawn grow.
sentences.zh: 我就要让我的草坪长着。

sentences.en: But instead, they do the communist thing, right?
sentences.zh: 但他们反其道而行之，搞起了共产主义那一套，对吧？

sentences.en: Which is collective management of what is essentially a moral commons.
sentences.zh: 也就是对本质上属于道德公地的事物进行集体管理。

sentences.en: Like, it's not your lawn.
sentences.zh: 比如，那不是你个人的草坪。

sentences.en: It's the whole community's lawn and you're responsible for this part.
sentences.zh: 那是整个社区的草坪，而你负责其中这一块。

sentences.en: Deviate from acceptable community norms and your community goes to war with you.
sentences.zh: 如果你偏离了社区公认的准则，整个社区就会与你为敌。

sentences.en: Which is how you get cases like Joe Prudente being thrown in jail for failing to keep his
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么会出现像乔·普鲁登特（Joe Prudente）这样的案例，他因为没能让自己的

sentences.en: lawn up to quote unquote community standards.
sentences.zh: 草坪达到所谓的“社区标准”而被关进监狱。

sentences.en: One of the guys in my cell, he says, what are you here for, Grandpa?
sentences.zh: 我牢房里的一个人问我：“爷爷，你是因为什么进来的？”

sentences.en: I said, grass.
sentences.zh: 我说：“草。”

sentences.en: He said, smoking it or selling it?
sentences.zh: 他说：“是抽草还是卖草？”

sentences.en: But as much as the lawn seems to be rooted to the American landscape, we may be seeing
sentences.zh: 但尽管草坪似乎已深深扎根于美国景观之中，我们或许正在见证

sentences.en: a transition.
sentences.zh: 一场变革。

sentences.en: At least here out weSt.
sentences.zh: 至少在我们西部是这样。

sentences.en: We're in an historic drought and that demands unprecedented action.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于历史性的干旱之中，这需要采取前所未有的行动。

sentences.en: It's for that reason that I'm issuing an executive order mandating substantial water
sentences.zh: 正因如此，我发布了一项行政命令，强制要求全州大幅度

sentences.en: reduction across our state.
sentences.zh: 减少用水量。

sentences.en: California Governor Jerry Brown declared in 2015 that our state would need to cut water
sentences.zh: 加州州长杰里·布朗（Jerry Brown）在2015年宣布，本州需要削减

sentences.en: use by 25 percent.
sentences.zh: 25%的用水量。

sentences.en: We're in a new era.
sentences.zh: 我们进入了一个新时代。

sentences.en: The idea of your nice little green grass getting lots of water every day, that's going to be
sentences.zh: 那种每天给漂亮的小绿草坪浇大量水的想法，即将

sentences.en: a thing of the paSt.
sentences.zh: 成为过去式。

sentences.en: Here in California, the lawn is perhaps the most visible symbol of the drought.
sentences.zh: 在加州，草坪或许是干旱最显眼的象征。

sentences.en: Water restrictions allow people to water only two or three times a week, down from four
sentences.zh: 节水限制规定人们每周只能浇水两到三次，而以前是四次

sentences.en: or five or even more.
sentences.zh: 甚至五次以上。

sentences.en: In California and Arizona and Nevada, governments are actually paying people to rip out their
sentences.zh: 在加州、亚利桑那州和内华达州，政府实际上在花钱请人铲掉他们的

sentences.en: grass.
sentences.zh: 草坪。

sentences.en: Prices range from a dollar to as much as four dollars per square foot of turf removed, which
sentences.zh: 价格从每平方英尺草皮一美元到四美元不等，

sentences.en: homeowners could then use to buy artificial turf or use it for xeriscaping, which is landscaping
sentences.zh: 房主可以用这笔钱购买人造草皮，或者进行旱地景观设计，也就是

sentences.en: with things that don't need water, like rocks.
sentences.zh: 用不需要水的材料进行景观美化，比如石头。

sentences.en: Some people are also choosing to put native plants in their yards, which theoretically should
sentences.zh: 有些人也选择在院子里种植原生植物，理论上它们

sentences.en: grow with rainwater only, and would help restore the ecosystem that had been there before.
sentences.zh: 仅靠雨水就能生长，并有助于恢复以前当地的生态系统。

sentences.en: Or you can just let your lawn go brown.
sentences.zh: 或者你也可以干脆让草坪枯黄。

sentences.en: California has a bunch of public service announcements that are all like,
sentences.zh: 加州发布了一系列公益广告，内容都是：

sentences.en: Get down with brown.
sentences.zh: 拥抱枯黄。

sentences.en: We'll get through this drought just fine.
sentences.zh: 我们一定能安然度过这场干旱。

sentences.en: Even our lawns.
sentences.zh: 即使我们的草坪也是如此。

sentences.en: Join the movement to help fight the drought.
sentences.zh: 加入抗旱运动吧。

sentences.en: Get down with brown.
sentences.zh: 拥抱枯黄。

sentences.en: Brown is the new green.
sentences.zh: 枯黄是新的绿色。

sentences.en: Do your part to help California fight the drought.
sentences.zh: 尽你的一份力，帮助加州抗击干旱。

sentences.en: Nobody bought a home in this country to have a brown lawn.
sentences.zh: 在这个国家，没人买房是为了留着一片枯黄的草坪。

sentences.en: This is America.
sentences.zh: 这里是美国。

sentences.en: We have green grass for a reason here.
sentences.zh: 我们这里有绿草是有原因的。

sentences.en: That's the American dream is to have a green lawn.
sentences.zh: 拥有绿色的草坪就是美国梦。

sentences.en: So invest a little bit in our service and you can have a green lawn during that drought season.
sentences.zh: 所以投资一点我们的服务，你就能在干旱季节拥有一片绿色的草坪。

sentences.en: This is David Bartlett of Extreme Green Grass.
sentences.zh: 我是“极致绿草”（Extreme Green Grass）的大卫·巴特利特（David Bartlett）。

sentences.en: He is decidedly not down with brown.
sentences.zh: 他显然并不打算“拥抱枯黄”。

sentences.en: I'm David Bartlett with Extreme Green Grass and we are turning her brown grass green.
sentences.zh: 我是“极致绿草”的大卫·巴特利特，我们正在把她枯黄的草坪变绿。

sentences.en: And he's doing this by literally painting a customer's lawn green.
sentences.zh: 他实现这一目标的方法，就是直接给客户的草坪喷上绿色油漆。

sentences.en: We are spraying on an all-natural, earth-friendly product that we manufacture called Extreme Green Grass.
sentences.zh: 我们喷洒的是一种我们制造的纯天然、环保的产品，叫作“极致绿草”。

sentences.en: It lasts three to six months.
sentences.zh: 效果可以持续三到六个月。

sentences.en: When we got there, the customer's grass was golden brown.
sentences.zh: 我们到那儿的时候，客户的草坪是金黄色的。

sentences.en: It hadn't been watered in six months.
sentences.zh: 已经六个月没浇过水了。

sentences.en: David uses a spray wand attached to a tank full of a liquid, which he swears is non-toxic.
sentences.zh: 大卫使用连接着装满液体罐子的喷杆，他发誓这种液体是无毒的。

sentences.en: And as he's spraying, it's like magic.
sentences.zh: 当他喷洒时，就像变魔术一样。

sentences.en: Like he's transforming a wheat field into a soccer pitch.
sentences.zh: 就像把麦田变成了足球场。

sentences.en: Except the grass is still crunchy.
sentences.zh: 只不过草摸起来还是脆的。

sentences.en: Yeah, the crunchiness doesn't change, unfortunately.
sentences.zh: 是的，遗憾的是，那种脆感不会改变。

sentences.en: If I could change that process, I'd be rich.
sentences.zh: 如果我能改变那个过程，我就发财了。

sentences.en: You do anything besides green?
sentences.zh: 除了绿色，你还做别的颜色吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, we do white that Christmas season.
sentences.zh: 有，圣诞节期间我们做白色。

sentences.en: Maybe it looks like you got a snowy yard.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像你的院子里积雪了一样。

sentences.en: Kind of looks like you went up and got some snow from the mountains.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像你从山上弄了些雪回来。

sentences.en: Yeah, anything like pink or purple, orange?
sentences.zh: 那粉色、紫色或橙色之类的呢？

sentences.en: Pink?
sentences.zh: 粉色？

sentences.en: Hey, I'll do that for you, bro.
sentences.zh: 嘿，兄弟，我可以为你做那个。

sentences.en: David got into this line of work after a friend got him a similar service for his lawn as a gift.
sentences.zh: 大卫是在一位朋友送给他类似的服务作为礼物后，才进入这一行的。

sentences.en: David had been working in landscaping and thought he could do a better job than the other companies he had seen.
sentences.zh: 大卫之前一直从事景观美化工作，他认为自己能比他见过的其他公司做得更好。

sentences.en: Lawn painting is actually not new.
sentences.zh: 草坪喷漆其实并不新鲜。

sentences.en: But if you've never heard of it, it's because it's generally only been used on golf courses and pro sports fields.
sentences.zh: 但如果你从未听说过，那是因为它通常只用于高尔夫球场和职业运动场。

sentences.en: It's only since this most recent drought that lawn painting has come home.
sentences.zh: 直到最近这次干旱，草坪喷漆才进入家庭。

sentences.en: When I first heard about lawn painting, I had assumed it would be scoffed at by the lawn obsessives,
sentences.zh: 当我第一次听说草坪喷漆时，我以为它会遭到那些草坪狂热者的嘲笑，

sentences.en: the kind of people who had Joe Prudente thrown in jail.
sentences.zh: 就是那种把乔·普鲁登特送进监狱的人。

sentences.en: But a lot of Extreme Greengrass's clients are homeowners associations.
sentences.zh: 但“极致绿草”的很多客户其实是业主协会。

sentences.en: Lawn painting is becoming accepted by even the strictest lawn enforcement agencies.
sentences.zh: 草坪喷漆甚至开始被最严格的草坪执法机构所接受。

sentences.en: It kind of makes you wonder if we as a society are beginning to question the supremacy of the perfectly kept lawn.
sentences.zh: 这不禁让人怀疑，作为一个社会，我们是否开始质疑完美修剪草坪的至高无上地位了。

sentences.en: Maybe we can finally quit lawn shaming each other.
sentences.zh: 也许我们终于可以停止互相进行“草坪羞辱”了。

sentences.en: This is America.
sentences.zh: 这里是美国。

sentences.en: We can always find ways to shame each other.
sentences.zh: 我们总能找到互相羞辱的方法。

sentences.en: I think it's very, very interesting to see what's happening in California with people getting on each other's case for having green grass.
sentences.zh: 我觉得看到加州发生的事情非常非常有趣，人们因为别人拥有绿色草坪而互相指责。

sentences.en: After all these decades of getting on each other's case for not having green grass.
sentences.zh: 毕竟几十年来，人们一直因为别人没有绿色草坪而互相指责。

sentences.en: That's Paul Robbins again.
sentences.zh: 那是保罗·罗宾斯（Paul Robbins）再次强调的。

sentences.en: Now we have a case where the drought has inspired people to really whack one another on the internet or whatever else,
sentences.zh: 现在我们看到，干旱促使人们在互联网或其他地方真正地互相攻击，

sentences.en: sort of shame people for putting water on their lawn.
sentences.zh: 某种程度上羞辱那些给草坪浇水的人。

sentences.en: See Twitter.
sentences.zh: 看看推特就知道了。

sentences.en: Hashtag drought shaming.
sentences.zh: 标签：干旱羞辱。

sentences.en: Paul says it's good that people are looking to conserve water,
sentences.zh: 保罗说，人们寻求节约用水是件好事，

sentences.en: but the moral architecture of drought shaming is a little too familiar.
sentences.zh: 但“干旱羞辱”背后的道德架构却让人感到太熟悉了。

sentences.en: It's just the newest trend on how people police each other's lawns.
sentences.zh: 这只是人们监管彼此草坪的最新趋势而已。

sentences.en: It's just another version of the same thing.
sentences.zh: 这不过是同一件事的另一个版本。

sentences.en: Like moral outrage that people are not doing their share
sentences.zh: 就像人们因为别人没有尽到责任而产生的道德义愤，

sentences.en: is sort of a natural response to people's land management,
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上是对人们土地管理方式的一种自然反应，

sentences.en: just like it was for keeping the lawn green.
sentences.zh: 就像当初为了保持草坪翠绿一样。

sentences.en: And so if David Bartlett does his job too well,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果大卫·巴特利特工作做得太好，

sentences.en: makes lawns look too much like they get tons of water,
sentences.zh: 让草坪看起来太像得到了充足的水分，

sentences.en: his customers might get drought shamed by people who have gotten a little too down with brown.
sentences.zh: 他的客户可能会遭到那些已经太过于“拥抱枯黄”的人的干旱羞辱。

sentences.en: As they say, the grass is always greener.
sentences.zh: 俗话说，别人的草坪总是更绿。

sentences.en: Even when it's browner.
sentences.zh: 即使它其实更黄。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Sam Greenspan,
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》（99% Invisible）由山姆·格林斯潘（Sam Greenspan）制作，

sentences.en: with Katie Mingle, Avery Truffelman, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 参与制作的还有凯蒂·明格（Katie Mingle）、艾弗里·特鲁费尔曼（Avery Truffelman）以及我，罗曼·马斯（Roman Mars）。

sentences.en: Thank you to Isaac Brown and Eric Flagg, directors of the film Gimme Green.
sentences.zh: 感谢电影《给我绿色》（Gimme Green）的导演艾萨克·布朗（Isaac Brown）和埃里克·弗拉格（Eric Flagg）。

sentences.en: That's where the tape of the lawn enforcement agent that you heard at the beginning of the story
sentences.zh: 你在故事开头听到的那位草坪执法人员的录音，

sentences.en: originally appeared.
sentences.zh: 最初就是出自那部电影。

sentences.en: We'll have a link to the film on our website.
sentences.zh: 我们会在网站上提供该电影的链接。

sentences.en: Thanks also to Devin Brown, Robert Fogelson, Brent Green,
sentences.zh: 还要感谢德文·布朗（Devin Brown）、罗伯特·福格尔森（Robert Fogelson）、布伦特·格林（Brent Green）、

sentences.en: Sharon Hall, Braden Kaye, Kelly Larson,
sentences.zh: 莎伦·霍尔（Sharon Hall）、布雷登·凯（Braden Kaye）、凯利·拉尔森（Kelly Larson）、

sentences.en: Molly Peterson, Taryn Smith, and Kelly Turner.
sentences.zh: 莫莉·彼得森（Molly Peterson）、塔琳·史密斯（Taryn Smith）和凯利·特纳（Kelly Turner）。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 KALW San Francisco
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7 KALW电台的一个项目，

sentences.en: and produced out of the offices of ArcScience,
sentences.zh: 在ArcScience的办公室制作，

sentences.en: an architecture and interiors firm
sentences.zh: 这是一家建筑与室内设计公司，

sentences.en: in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 位于美丽的加州奥克兰市中心。

sentences.en: You can find this show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到并关注我们的节目。

sentences.en: We're all on Twitter, Tumblr, Instagram, and Spotify,
sentences.zh: 我们都在推特、Tumblr、Instagram和Spotify上，

sentences.en: but you can listen to every single episode of 99% Invisible,
sentences.zh: 但你可以收听《99%隐形》的每一集节目，

sentences.en: and we have pictures and lots of other stuff there too
sentences.zh: 那里还有图片和许多其他内容，

sentences.en: at 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 网址是99pi.org。

sentences.en: Videotopia.
sentences.zh: 视频乌托邦。
